snapshot.title: kiln list and kiln show
snapshot.description:
Read commands.

- `kiln list`: features in rank order with their tasks, showing ID, title, effective status, blocked and claim. Filters: `--kind`, `--project`, `--feature`, `--status`. `--json` prints the protojson response for scripting.
- `kiln show <id>`: one item with its description, dependencies, work state and revision.
- `kiln history <id>` with `--children` and `--notes`.

Add commands with `cobra-cli add <name> -a "Peter Rauhut" -l none` from `cmd/kiln/`.
